severityCalibration: MUST-FIX = repair required before adoption (unsound or protocol-violating as drafted); SHOULD-FIX = real defect, repairable without changing the decision's core; NOTE = observation or positive verification. The D-000 clause-3 alternatives/rationale omission is common to all four drafts; its severity per entry tracks how load-bearing the unrecorded trade is to that entry's soundness (D-008 and D-011: the trade IS the decision's content, MUST-FIX; D-010: secondary to the row's existence, folded into D-010-3 SHOULD-FIX; D-009: near-zero trade space, folded into D-009-2 SHOULD-FIX).

D-008.claim: The entry does not name the file-08 edit it carries. Its only row disposition is 'Row -> the acceptance recorded; evidence half ... at DR-G14 qualification' - no status label from file 08's closed vocabulary, no annotation text. This fails the lane's own discipline: D-006 named the DR-115 move to DECIDED-V1-NOT-INTEGRATED with its annotation in the entry (and its turn-2 NOTE-03 holds the closed status vocabulary closed); D-007 did the same for DR-118 (NOTE-9). The C-D006 commit incident ('its message overclaimed - it carried NO register or file-08 edits') is this lane's recorded cost of unnamed edits.
D-008.evidence: COORDINATOR-DECISIONS.md D-008 ('Row -> the acceptance recorded'); file 08 status vocabulary (lines 20-29: HARD-BLOCKED / OPEN / PROPOSED-CLOSED-FOR-REVIEW / DECIDED-V1-NOT-INTEGRATED / SATISFIED); DR-119 current status at file 08 line 282: 'OPEN - proposed product rule, acceptance decision queued (normalized to the declared vocabulary 2026-08-13, C4)'; DR-115/DR-118 rows (lines 278/281) as the required pattern; D-006 commit note.
D-008.proposedFix: Name the edit in the entry: on adoption, C-D008 moves DR-119 to DECIDED-V1-NOT-INTEGRATED - annotated 'product rule ACCEPTED (D-008); evidence half (signed closures, clean-machine offline tests, manifest declarations) discharges at DR-G14 qualification' - and adds the D-008 citation to the row's source cell, per the DR-115/DR-118 pattern.

D-008.claim: 'ACCEPTED as binding for slice 1 ... the rule binds future roles at their own acceptance' weakens the row's universal quantifier. The row's cell opens 'For every supported language role:' and its impact cell reads 'Hard blocker for every supported language role'; file 02's rule is 'binding only if accepted through DR-119' - i.e., acceptance makes it binding simpliciter for every supported role, not per-slice and not per-role-at-their-own-acceptance. As drafted, a future role's acceptance decision becomes a fresh forum where the rule's application to that role is decided - a re-litigation hook the row does not contain.
D-008.evidence: File 08 line 282 (cell + impact); file 02 lines 224-230 ('Every supported programming-language analyzer/tool component supplies ... inside its signed, verified, platform-qualified component closure'); D-008 decision text.
D-008.proposedFix: Accept the rule universally as the row states it, and scope only the EVIDENCE: 'the rule is accepted for every supported language role; slice 1's sole role is TypeScript (D-002); a future role's acceptance discharges this rule's evidence for that role and cannot re-decide the rule.'

D-008.claim: The restatement silently narrows the rule it accepts. Word-by-word against the row's cell: (a) 'manifest licenses/SBOM/attestation/platform/capability/performance declarations' is dropped entirely - in file 02 the manifest declarations are part of the RULE ('The component manifest declares every bundled runtime/tool byte and exact tree, entrypoint/loader binding, license/notice, SBOM and attestation...'), not merely DR-G14 evidence; (b) the cell's two separate items 'ambient/implicit-download refusal; typed remediation' are merged into 'ambient/implicit-download refusal is typed', losing the typed-unavailable-result-with-explicit-local/offline-remediation obligation; (c) file 02's 'It never silently substitutes a system tool or weakens semantics' has no counterpart.
D-008.evidence: File 08 line 282 cell vs D-008 decision text; file 02 lines 232-238.
D-008.proposedFix: Either restate completely, or accept by pinned reference and mark the summary non-normative: 'the rule accepted is file 02 sec. Language runtime and toolchain UX as pinned at 1811c682..., restated here non-normatively.'

D-008.claim: The exception path is compressed below its source. File 02's exception requires: explicit product approval; NAMING ownership/trust/network/prerequisites; appearance in manifest AND doctor output; typed absence/failure behavior; and 'never marketed or silently treated as a supported self-contained language analyzer'. D-008 retains only approval + doctor contract + 'never labeled self-contained' (DR-G14's short form). 'Labeled' is strictly narrower than 'marketed or silently treated' - silent treatment is behavior, not labeling - and manifest visibility, the named prerequisites, and typed absence/failure vanish.
D-008.evidence: File 02 lines 240-245; DR-G14 row applicability cell ('exception only by explicit product approval and never labeled self-contained'); D-008 decision text.
D-008.proposedFix: Carry the exception contract in full or by pinned reference; keep 'never marketed or silently treated as a supported self-contained language analyzer' as the operative phrase.

D-008.claim: No alternatives-considered and no rationale section, in a PREFERENCE-LADEN product acceptance with a real trade space (accept-as-written vs amend the exception breadth vs defer acceptance to DR-G14 evidence time; universal binding vs the drafted per-role construction). D-000 clause 3 and the register's own entry format require both; D-007's 'Alternatives considered (SF-8, recorded per D-000 clause 3)' is the lane's enforcement precedent.
D-008.evidence: COORDINATOR-DECISIONS.md lines 9-12 (entry format), 36-38 (clause 3); D-007 SF-8 section; D-008 as drafted (neither section exists).
D-008.proposedFix: Add alternatives-considered and rationale sections before adoption.

D-009.claim: There is nothing to DECIDE here beyond assent, and the entry should say so honestly. The row already declares the baseline mandatory ('Standard command-oriented CLI ... is mandatory baseline UX'; impact: 'Hard blocker for every first blueprint slice; it is not conditional on TUI scope'), and file 01 already states the baseline normatively ('The baseline UX is a standard command-oriented CLI with stable human-readable and machine-readable projections that work non-interactively in CI'). The only free content is assent versus opening an MF-6 register-content amendment to reject/amend the row. Labeling the whole entry PREFERENCE-LADEN overstates the discretion exercised; D-001's hybrid labeling ('RULE-GOVERNED in its adoption ... PREFERENCE-LADEN in the specific routes') is the lane's honest form. The entry also records no alternatives (the dissent path) - the clause-3 gap, rated inside this item because the trade space is near-zero.
D-009.evidence: File 08 line 286; file 01 sec. 'Output projections, including SARIF' (lines 135-138); D-001 sec. 2 ('DR-123 makes the CLI baseline mandatory for every slice') and D-001's hybrid decision-type; D-000 clause 3.
D-009.proposedFix: Either relabel 'RULE-GOVERNED acceptance of a register-mandated baseline; PREFERENCE-LADEN only in the assent itself', or keep PREFERENCE-LADEN and state expressly that the entry's sole free content is assent, naming the considered alternative (reject/amend via an MF-6 register-content entry) and why it was not taken.

D-009.claim: The paraphrase drops 'core': the cell reads 'Every first-slice core command'; D-009 reads 'every slice-1 command'. No live divergence (all slice-1 commands - analyze, doctor, --help/--version - are core, and 'per the row's cell' anchors by reference), but an acceptance should not re-quantify the cell it accepts.

D-010.claim: The acceptance-evidence cell is undecidable and paraphrases below its source. 'The no-silent-loss rule' is defined NOWHERE in the corpus (verified by sweep; the only near-hit is passing prose in steering/03). File 05's actual rule is a six-member enumeration ('No migration silently downloads, refreshes an index, mutates a lock, creates replacement historical identities, rewrites evidence meaning, or treats telemetry/network as required'), and file 05 additionally requires the transition to preserve five things (tracked intent, no-write pre-initialization value, per-value provenance, historical identities/custody, promised offline behavior) and distinguish five pairs (distribution vs user-custody migration; management-only adoption vs authoritative-closure install; immutable coexistence vs in-place mutation; removal vs purge; replay pinning vs typed degradation). The proposed cell compresses all of this to three coverages plus an unnamed rule - minting at DR-130's birth exactly the row-vs-source drift class (five-vs-seven) that D-011 is simultaneously repairing. 'Reviewed' is also unqualified: the vocabulary's SATISFIED grade requires INDEPENDENT review.
D-010.evidence: File 05 sec. 'Migration constraints' (lines 67-81, full text read); corpus grep for 'no-silent-loss' (zero definitions); file 08 line 29 (SATISFIED: 'independently reviewed'); D-010 cell text; D-011's own premise that paraphrase drift is a defect class.
D-010.proposedFix: Bind the cell to the boundary source (the D-007 SF-6 cure): 'an independently reviewed transition statement conforming to file 05 sec. Migration constraints (its preserve list, five distinctions, and no-silent enumeration), stating what V1-prototype state (if any) migrates and what is explicitly abandoned with notice.'

D-010 is silent about the site. The stale quote is survivable only because SF-3's evaluation rule ('over the register as it stands at readiness evaluation') lives in the same entry - but that rescue must be recorded, not left to a careful reader.
D-010.evidence: COORDINATOR-DECISIONS.md lines 95-118 (blockquote), 254-261 (SF-3 new-row rule, read verbatim); ADV-D001-T2-05 in coordinator-decisions.D-001.review-adversarial.turn2.json; corpus-wide quantifier grep: exactly three doc sites (file 08 line 348; COORDINATOR-DECISIONS.md lines 107 and 258) - file 02's readiness banner uses different ranges and is unaffected because DR-130 pins file 05.
D-010.proposedFix: D-010 names the second site and records the governing rule: the sec. 1 blockquote is a historical quote pinned to D-001's anchor digest 528cab56... and SF-3's evaluation rule governs; optionally C-D010 adds a dated editorial bracket beneath the blockquote as a recorded act named in this entry - never a silent edit of adopted bytes.

D-010.claim: The range-to-range amendment re-arms the staleness trap it discharges: 'DR-101 through DR-130' goes stale again at DR-131, and every future new-row commit must remember the wording amendment forever. The range-free cure is already ON THE RECORD in the lane's own authority chain - ADV-D001-T2-05's proposedFix: amend condition 2's wording to e.g. 'all rows of the V2 architecture and product decisions table', which preserves SF-3's growth-only-by-recorded-act guarantee (a row can only exist via a reviewed decision). D-010 adopts the literal-range horn without recording the alternative or why - the clause-3 gap, rated here because the wording choice is secondary to the row's existence.
D-010.evidence: ADV-D001-T2-05 proposedFix (turn-2 verdict); D-001 SF-3 text; D-010 amendment text; D-000 clause 3.
D-010.proposedFix: Either amend to the range-free wording with SF-3 cited as the growth guard, or keep the literal range and record the range-free alternative with the reason for rejecting it (e.g., auditability of the exact set at each adoption) plus the standing obligation that every future new-row commit re-amends the wording.

D-011.claim: Verbatim duplication is chosen over the lane's own boundary-source cure, with zero alternatives recorded and no sync obligation. Copying file 02's seven items into the DR-117 Decision column creates a second normative copy of a list, and reproduces the exact drift mechanism under repair: the current five-item column is itself a paraphrase that drifted from its source, and a verbatim copy is a paraphrase at distance zero that merely starts synchronized - the next lawful file-02 boundary change re-creates the mismatch silently. The lane cured precisely this class one day earlier by reference, not by copy (D-007 SF-6: the enumerated areas are 'an ILLUSTRATIVE FLOOR; the manifest is the boundary source ... the register's own quantifier-as-boundary cure'), and D-001's new-row rule shows the lane DOES record sync obligations when two texts must agree. D-011 records neither the by-reference alternative nor any sync rule, and has no rationale section (D-000 clause 3) - in a decision whose entire content is the trade between the two shapes.
D-011.evidence: Independently verified at current bytes: DR-117's Decision column names FIVE items (marketplace/catalog depth, imperative contributions, untrusted native/WASM, probes, network grants - file 08 line 280); file 02 enumerates SEVEN binding items (lines 286-293), adding external lifecycle parity and discovery (item 2), contribution roles beyond narrow/data-only (item 3), and replacement of the full-default G3 physical substrate (item 7), and carrying qualifiers the row drops ('admission and required enforcement evidence', 'project hooks, and root commands', 'egress defaults'). File 02's digest equals the DR-205 frozen digest 1811c682... (file 02 unchanged since DR-205 - D-011's premise CONFIRMED); DR-205's row cites the mismatch as the KNOWN queued widening (V2TOPIC-F-04/C4b). D-007 SF-6; D-000 clause 3; file 08 preamble's single-list-owner principle.
D-011.proposedFix: Either (a) widen by reference: Decision column reads 'Product-boundary successor explicitly dispositioning ALL SEVEN binding items of file 02 sec. Current V1 product boundary and required successors (count and content verified at 1811c682..., re-verified at edit time; DR-205 KNOWN-VERIFIED cited)' - one authoritative copy, count-pinned; or (b) keep the verbatim enumeration AND record the by-reference alternative with the reason rejected, plus a sync rule mirroring D-001's new-row rule: any lawful change to file 02's seven items MUST carry the DR-117 row edit in the same commit. Add the missing alternatives/rationale sections either way.

D-011.claim: The re-verification failure path is unstated: the entry re-verifies file 02 at edit time but does not say what happens if the bytes have moved off 1811c682....
D-011.proposedFix: State it: on mismatch the edit aborts and the discrepancy routes through DR-205's successor path before any widening lands.
